state_ewurum2025_pbs_lignin_r30_injectio.source_scope: Study-qualified DCP-reactive PBS / 30 wt.% Indulin AT softwood kraft lignin formulation R30 (Ewurum and McDonald 2025); lignin percentage is relative to total polymer mass. The nominal DCP-containing formulation and source-reported reaction distinguish this R-series from the corresponding B-series simple blend.
